# Annie's Nails & Spa

> Nails & spa based in Pflugerville, Texas. Acrylic full sets, gel manis, French tips, nail art, pedicures and waxing in a simple, cozy salon on W Pecan St in Pflugerville. Walk in, grab a drink and take your time at the polish wall.

- Phone: (512) 989-1161
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, North Austin, Manor
- Google rating: 4.3 from 166 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/annies-nails-and-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/annies-nails-and-spa/book.html

## Services
- Acrylic full sets & fills: Coffin, square or almond, long or short, kept fresh with fills.
- Gel & powder manis: Glossy gel or powder color that holds up, from classic red to neon.
- French tips & nude: Clean white French tips and soft natural nude sets.
- Nail art: Bring a photo or an idea and we'll paint it on.
- Pedicures: A bubbly foot soak, hot towels, callus care and a massage, with a drink to start.
- Waxing: Quick, private waxing services alongside your nails.

## About
Annie's Nails & Spa is a neighborhood nail salon at 1912 W Pecan St, Suite 202, in a Pflugerville plaza with plenty of parking. Inside: warm cream walls, a long row of manicure stations, burgundy pedicure chairs and a floor-to-ceiling wall of polish under big landscape paintings. Clients describe it as simple and cozy, relaxing and less noisy. It's owner-run: Tammy runs the place and Andy works the table beside her, and regulars mention them both by name. Some clients have been coming for more than ten years. They talk about a drink to start, a bubbly foot soak and hot towels, techs who explain the options and take their time, and fair prices. Bring a photo or an idea. Ruby glitter, purple hearts, neon yellow coffins, a natural nude or a clean white French: every photo on this site comes from real clients' visits.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Saturday 9 am to 7 pm, Sunday 11 am to 5 pm. Closed Mondays.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk in anytime we're open, or call (512) 989-1161 to check for an open chair.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 1912 W Pecan St, Suite 202, Pflugerville, TX 78660, in the plaza on W Pecan St with plenty of parking.
- Q: Do you do powder or dip nails?
  A: Yes. We do powder nails, and your tech will walk you through the options so you get the look you want.
- Q: Do you do waxing?
  A: Yes: Brazilian, chest and back waxing, alongside nails and pedicures.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo or describe what you want: hearts, glitter, accents, French, ombre, any color from the polish wall.
